manaNeeded: {6}{W}{U}, plus {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Leveler.
Cast Alliance of Arms by paying {W}, paying at least {1} as it resolves and causing each player to create a number of Leveler tokens equal to the amount of mana paid.
Each of the token copies of Leveler enter the battlefield, triggering themselves, exiling their controllers' libraries.
